## Status values

`proposed`, `accepted`, `deprecated`, `superseded`

## Adding one

1. Copy `docs/decisions/_template.md` to a new file named after its ID.
2. Fill every field; run `python -m kernel.docs_plane --write` (or `make docs`) to regenerate this index.
3. Commit the file and the index together; `scripts/verify.sh` refuses a file without its row.
